content.comment_body: Can anyone advise? I have a project requiring 8 digital inputs, 2 analog inputs, and 4 digital outputs. Which [product_name] model would fit my needs? The [product_name] model with designation [article_no] mentions 8 digital inputs (including 2 analog) and 4 digital outputs. If I configure 2 inputs for analog signals, do I have 6 or 8 digital inputs remaining?

You can only allocate each input either as digital or analog, so if you use 2 as analog, you have 6 digital inputs left. You'll need to expand your [product_name] system with either a digital or analog expansion module based on your requirements. Keep in mind, base module analog inputs are 0-10V only; if you have other signal types, an analog expansion module is necessary. It's also helpful to plan for extra I/O for future upgrades.
Thanks [user_name]. I'll likely expand the system with a digital extension module.

The most effective approach is to use the [product_name] model [article_no] with its 8 digital inputs and 4 digital outputs. Add an AM2 extension unit for the 2 analog inputs. These units can be selected for 0-10V or 0/4-20mA inputs. Remember, the extension must be powered separately via DC.
Can I control a 100V DC motor directly with an output relay?

My recommendation: use an external relay for switching the motor. The built-in relay in the [product_name] is not designed for prolonged motor operation, and an external relay is easier to replace if needed.

In these situations, you can use a contactor compatible with [product_name] design, available in 24V or 230V versions. For example, reference [article_no] (24V) or [article_no] (230V). Visual reference provided here.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges understanding how digital and analog inputs are allocated within the [product_name] base module, as assigning analog inputs reduces available digital inputs. They are seeking advice on expanding I/O capacity and clarification on safely controlling external devices, such as DC motors, through output relays. This highlights the need for clearer documentation and expansion guidance regarding the hardware capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to allow simultaneous use of all specified inputs and outputs, as well as straightforward methods for directly controlling devices like DC motors. They seek clear options for system expansion and better documentation on input assignment.
